<meta>Page number: 2 (Chinese: 二). Header in Chinese: 大寶積經第二卷上 (Great Heap of Jewels Sutra, Scroll 2, Part 1).</meta>
<header>The Sutra of the Great Heap of Jewels <note>Chinese: "大寶積經"; Sanskrit: <term>Mahāratnakūṭasūtra</term> <gloss>Sutra of the Great Heap of Jewels</gloss>; Mongolian: <term>Qutug-tu yeke erdeni dabqurlagsan sudur</term> <gloss>Noble Sutra of the Great Heap of Jewels</gloss></note>, Scroll Two, Part One</header>
<note>Ornamental red-printed double rectangular border with floral scrollwork enclosing the text block, with side panels on the left and right.</note>
<margin>First <note>Mongolian: "ᠳᠡ ᠨᠢᠭᠡ" (<term>de nige</term> <gloss>section marker "de", one</gloss>), corresponding to the Chinese character <term>de</term> <gloss>virtue; used here as a volume index character from the Thousand Character Classic</gloss></note>, <term>debter</term> <gloss>volume or folio</gloss> two <note>original: "ᠳᠡ ᠨᠢᠭᠡ ᠳᠡᠪᠲᠡᠷ ᠬᠣᠶᠠᠷ"</note></margin>

<unclear>19 vertical lines of Classical Mongolian script printed in red ink (Kangxi era Mongolian Kanjur, Qutug-tu yeke erdeni dabqurlagsan sudur / Mahāratnakūṭasūtra, Vol. 49, folio 2a), not transcribed</unclear>

<summary>This folio is page 2a from the second scroll of the Sutra of the Great Heap of Jewels (Maharatnakutasutra) in the Kangxi-era red-printed Mongolian Kanjur. It includes bilingual Chinese and Mongolian marginal indexing markers, while the main block of nineteen vertical lines of Classical Mongolian text remains untranscribed in the source OCR.</summary>
<keywords>Maharatnakutasutra, Sutra of the Great Heap of Jewels, Mongolian Kanjur, Kangxi edition, Classical Mongolian, Buddhist canon, red-ink printing</keywords>
